card.title: There Is a Process
card.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Urgency noted. Please sign without dripping on the terms.

mechanism: A converts a rain-soaked person's umbrella request into a loan application with duration, guarantee and signature terms.
confusable: Unlike cautious lending alone, A must process even visible urgency as another administrative field.
comparison: Immediate weather exposure becomes form handling, unlike the wedding scene's emotional reassurance categories.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
